\begin{document}
The transmission of the symmetric junction is
\begin{equation}
T(\omega) = \frac{4\Gamma_L\Gamma_R}{(\Gamma_L+\Gamma_R)^2} ,
\label{eq:t1}
\end{equation}
and expanding the denominator,
\begin{equation}
T(\omega) = \frac{4\Gamma_L\Gamma_R}{\Gamma_L^2+2\Gamma_L\Gamma_R+\Gamma_R^2} .
\label{eq:t2}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
